jobs.title: Senior Manager – BI & Reporting and Product Management
jobs.description:
Overview:

As part of the PGCS D\&AI organisation, the role leads the delivery of Business Intelligence and Reporting products, with Power BI as the primary platform. The role partners with business and other technical teams to shape reporting requirements, define scalable data and semantic solutions, manage demand intake, and ensure successful build, delivery and sustainment of reporting product.

  


Responsibilities:

Key Responsibilities

* Data Ingestion \& Integration – Microsoft Fabric data ingestion and integration, including SAP BW/HANA and other enterprise data sources.
* Data Transformation \& Engineering – Developing scalable ETL/ELT pipelines, Dataflows and Notebooks to cleanse, transform and prepare data using a modern Medallion Architecture.
* Data Modelling – Designing performant dimensional models and Star Schemas, including fact/dimension structures, relationships and business\-ready semantic models.
* Power BI Visualisation – Developing intuitive, business\-focused Power BI reports and dashboards, translating wireframes into effective visualisations and user experiences.

Qualifications: **Skills Required**

* Strong Power BI delivery experience — report and dashboard development, DAX, semantic models, performance optimisation and deployment practices.
* Working knowledge of Microsoft Fabric — ingestion and integration.
* Experience integrating SAP BW/HANA and other enterprise data sources into analytics and reporting platforms.
* ETL pipeline delivery on a Medallion Architecture, with an understanding of data quality, reconciliation and refresh management.
* SQL for querying, validation and data analysis; familiarity with the Azure Data \& Analytics stack including Data Lake, Blob Storage, Azure Data Factory, Synapse and Databricks.
* Functional and technical data experience in Supply Chain and Commercial domains is preferred;

**Experience Required**

* Degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, Business Management or a related field.
* 10\+ years of experience in Data \& Analytics, with a substantial portion in Business Intelligence and reporting delivery.
* Demonstrated experience leading enterprise Power BI and data platform programmes end to end, from ingestion through to published reporting.

**Leadership \& Behavioural Expectations**

* Strong stakeholder management and communication skills, with the ability to understand business needs and translate them into reporting and data solutions. A strong problem\-solving mindset, comfort with ambiguity, and the ability to lead priorities across functional teams are essential, alongside a deep understanding of business processes, data and end\-to\-end operations.

jobs.title: Manager/Senior Manager - Product Marketing
jobs.description:
Zenoti provides an all\-in\-one, cloud\-based software solution for the beauty and wellness industry. Our solution allows users to seamlessly manage every aspect of the business in a comprehensive mobile solution: online appointment bookings, POS, CRM, employee management, inventory management, built\-in marketing programs and more. Zenoti helps clients streamline their systems and reduce costs, while simultaneously improving customer retention and spending. Our platform is engineered for reliability and scale and harnesses the power of enterprise\-level technology for businesses of all sizes



Zenoti powers more than 30,000 salons, spas, medspas and fitness studios in over 50 countries. This includes a vast portfolio of global brands, such as European Wax Center, Hand \& Stone, Massage Heights, Rush Hair \& Beauty, Sono Bello, Profile by Sanford, Hair Cuttery, CorePower Yoga and TONI\&GUY.



Our recent accomplishments include surpassing a $1 billion unicorn valuation, being named Next Tech Titan by GeekWire, raising an $80 million investment from TPG, ranking as the 316th fastest\-growing company in North America on Deloitte's 2020 Technology Fast 500™. We are also proud to be recognized as a Great Place to Work CertifiedTM for 2021\-2022 as this reaffirms our commitment to empowering people to feel good and find their greatness. To learn more about Zenoti visit: https://www.zenoti.com

 **What will I be doing?**


* Product Positioning – define and document product hierarchy, messaging, core market differentiation and create messaging for solutions and feature sets within our product, both for overarching brand and for the different stages of the customer journey
* Market \& Competitive Intelligence – understand our target audience, competitors as well as general innovation relevant to our industry and its different verticals. Develop and iterate our ICPs.
* GTM Strategy \& Product Launches – own and manage the GTM strategy for relevant product portfolio, including new product launches and major product releases, working closely with sales, product, customer success and adoption teams.
* Content Generation – deliver high\-quality product marketing materials (brochures, sales decks, website copy, datasheets, battle cards, demo videos, marketing videos, etc.) to support demand generation campaigns, sales cycles, and product and features adoption.
* Demand Generation – support and work with our extended marketing team on lead generation activities, with messaging, collateral and ensure sales has appropriate follow up materials and enablement tools to execute on leads.
* Elevate, and eventually manage, a team of PMMs \- create a culture of success and continuous improvement by mentoring, managing, and expanding the product marketing team, including establishing ambitious OKRs to keep the team strategically aligned.

  


**What skills do I need?**


* Ability to understand complex technical products and translate them into marketing deliverables.
* Monitor and deliver customer feedback and competitive intelligence to sales, marketing, and product management teams.
* Experience executing awareness and adoption campaigns to existing customers through different channels.
* Adept at tracking and measuring impact with data.
* Curiosity to learn and execute new ideas.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with ability to communicate complex information in a concise and compelling manner.
* Can work in a fast paced, ever changing, startup\-like environment.
* You have a BA/BS degree (MBA preferred).
* You bring 12\+ years of marketing experience with 5\+ doing tech marketing, preferably in a B2B SaaS or enterprise software environment.
* 2\+ years managing high performing teams.
* Demonstrated experience as a team and cross\-functional leader that can mentor and manage team members while balancing requirements and delivering on goals.
* You are highly organized and efficient, juggling multiple projects at once with high reliability.
* A big plus if you bring experience within the wellness and beauty industry.

  


**Why Zenoti?**


* Be part of an innovative company that is revolutionizing the wellness and beauty industry.
* Work with a dynamic and diverse team that values collaboration, creativity, and growth.
* Opportunity to lead impactful projects and help shape the global success of Zenoti's platform.
* Attractive compensation.
* Medical coverage for yourself and your immediate family.
* Access to regular yoga, meditation, breathwork, and stress management sessions. We also include your family in benefit awareness initiatives.
* Regular social activities, and opportunities to give back through social work and community initiatives.

*Zenoti provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local laws.**This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment, including recruiting, hiring, placement, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, transfer, leaves of absence, compensation and training.*

jobs.description:
**Company Description**  

It all started when engineer Fred Luddy wrote code that automated a tedious task for his coworker, Phyllis. She cried tears of joy. That moment inspired Fred to build a company that could do that for everyone—freeing people from busywork so they could focus on meaningful work. Today, ServiceNow is the AI control tower for business reinvention. Our ServiceNow AI platform brings together any AI, any data, and any workflow— helping 85% of the Fortune 500® work smarter, faster, and better. We're building an AI\-native culture where technology and talent are unstoppable together. And we're just getting started.


Join us to put AI to work for people.

 **Job Description**  

ServiceNow is changing the way people work. With a service\-orientation toward the activities, tasks and processes that make up day\-to\-day work life, we help the modern enterprise operate faster and be more scalable than ever before.


We are looking for a Staff Product Manager who can help lead the effort to build a consumer\-grade user experience for ServiceNow’s products. Our users are the employees of the world’s largest companies and our mission is to provide them a user experience at work that is comparable to the user experiences they are used to using at home.


You will be a member of the product team that is responsible for building the consumer\-grade web, mobile and conversational experiences that make up our AI front door to work, where an employee asks, acts and accomplishes in one place, across ServiceNow’s business units.

**What you get to do in this role:**

* Contributing to the ServiceNow vision for how employees get their work done, across interfaces and business units
* Partnering with PMs across ServiceNow business units to understand their products and use cases and champion enhancements needed for a better service experience
* Working with the UX design and research teams to design and validate awesome cross\-interface experiences that balance the different outcomes involved in service experiences
* Crafting content that evangelizes our vision for a consumer\-grade employee experience – both for internal stake holders and customers.

  

**Qualifications** **To be successful in this role you have:**

* Experience in leveraging or critically thinking about how to integrate AI into work processes, decision\-making, or problem\-solving. This may include using AI\-powered tools, automating workflows, analyzing AI\-driven insights, or exploring AI's potential impact on the function or industry.
* Has 7\+ years in product management with experience building consumer or employee facing user interfaces. Plus points for experience with B2B SaaS products and for having built mobile experiences.
* Is AI\-native in how they work and in what they build, has shipped AI\-powered experiences, and holds a point of view on where AI belongs in an employee experience and where it does not
* Strong attention to detail, with the technical depth to partner with engineering and the design sensibility to partner with UX
* Enjoys collaborating with other teams, leading by influence and by evangelizing a vision
* Thinks holistically about the business objectives, collaborating cross\-functionally to drive GTM workstreams e.g. customer \& partner enablement, beyond delivering great product .
* Thrives in ambiguity and enjoys working in a fast paced and collaborative environment
* Has exceptional presentation skills and the ability to relate to various level of stakeholders, including communicating with senior leadership and managing stakeholders across business units.
* Has experience working in an agile product management environment; writing stories, grooming with developers, managing sprints etc
* Brings energy, curiosity, independence, humility and a sense of humor to the office every day.

  

We provide competitive compensation, generous benefits and a professional atmosphere. This is a very collaborative and inclusive work environment where individuals strong on aptitude and attitude will have an opportunity to grow their professional careers through working with some of the most advanced technology and talented developers in the business.

jobs.title: Product Supply Planning Manager
jobs.description:
Azurity Pharmaceuticals is a privately held, specialty pharmaceutical company that focuses on innovative products that meet the needs of underserved patients. As an industry leader in providing unique, accessible, and high\-quality medications, Azurity leverages its integrated capabilities and vast partner network to continually expand its broad commercial product portfolio and robust late\-stage pipeline. The company's patient\-centric products span the cardiovascular, neurology, endocrinology, gastro\-intestinal, institutional, and orphan markets, and have benefited millions of patients. For more information, visit www.azurity.com.



Azurity Pharmaceuticals is proud to be an inclusive workplace and an Equal Opportunity Employer. Azurity's success is attributable to our incredibly talented, dedicated team that focuses on benefiting the lives of patients by bringing the best science and commitment to quality into everything that we do. We seek highly motivated individuals with the dedication, integrity, and creative spirit needed to thrive in our organization.

**About the Role**



Azurity Pharmaceuticals is a privately held, specialty pharmaceutical company that focuses on innovative products that meet the needs of underserved patients. Our Supply Chain team is growing, and we are looking to strengthen it with a passionate and driven team member. If you are eager to be part of a dynamic, global, and fast\-growing organization—where a positive mindset, personal development, and making a meaningful impact on people's health are valued—we could be the perfect match. As Product Supply Planning Manager, you will own the end\-to\-end supply plan for our Contract Manufacturing Organizations (CMOs), collaborate across departments, and play an active role in shaping the future of our company.


**Key Responsibilities**


* Create and maintain the supply plan for CMOs on a monthly basis, considering inventory and open orders (firmed and planned), to identify and communicate status to internal and external stakeholders.
* Based on the supply plan, issue Purchase Orders and forecasts to CMOs, and monitor deliveries of purchase orders against requested dates.
* Proactively manage supply constraints to minimize business impact.
* Provide accurate and complete supply planning parameters and purchasing conditions for all SKUs; act as the Expert User for key planning Master Data.
* Set and maintain all required Master Data and ensure its integrity and correctness.
* Create and maintain strong working relationships with internal and external partners.
* Oversee the successful launch of new products into the market, ensuring timely supply, regulatory compliance, and effective coordination with manufacturing and distribution teams.
* Propose stock holding levels within the supply chain through a detailed understanding of key planning parameters and the E2E process (safety stock, lead times, supply reliability, demand variability, service objectives), in line with Working Capital targets.

jobs.title: (Agentic) Product Manager
jobs.description:
**About This Role**
 We are building an agentic banking platform for large enterprise banks. Multi\-modal AI converts business intent into autonomous agents that orchestrate processes, integrate data, and make intelligent decisions — turning weeks of manual work into hours.
   

  

 You will lead AI agents and intelligent automation — building capabilities that deploy autonomous agents to solve complex banking problems at enterprise scale. This is not a pillar\-specific role. You'll work across three interconnected pillars (Durable Processes, Data Connectors, AI Agents), collaborating with peer PMs to architect and ship agentic solutions end\-to\-end.
   

  

 You'll report directly to the Product Director and own the complete journey: from defining what agentic capabilities matter most, to shipping them, to measuring their impact. This role is for a PM who understands how AI agents fundamentally change enterprise automation, who can navigate technical and business complexity, and who ships with both ambition and rigor.
   

  

**What You'll Own**
 Strategic ownership
   

  

* Define the AI capability roadmap — which features move the needle, which delight customers, which drive competitive advantage
* Make the hard calls: what ships in Year 1, what comes after, what's out of scope
* Own the quality bar — "enterprise grade" means reliable, explainable, compliant, and safe. Set and enforce that standard.
* Shape how AI surfaces across the platform — consistency in UX, tone, and behavior across copilot, solution builder, and other capabilities


 Execution leadership
   

  

* Lead cross\-pillar alignment — work with peer PMs to define integration points and success metrics
* Conduct customer discovery: what AI capabilities matter most, what fears do they have about AI, what use cases are most valuable
* Make data\-driven decisions: usage patterns, LLM cost, inference latency, customer sentiment all inform roadmap
* Unblock ambiguity: when technical feasibility isn't clear (cost, latency, quality), you synthesize information and move forward decisively


 Partnership with platform PMs
   

  

* Collaborate with peer PMs who own the platform pillars
* Establish clear integration contracts: where AI surfaces in their UIs, how data flows from their features to your LLM calls, how they measure success


**We're Looking For**
**Experience Shipping One Or More Of The Following**
 AI\-native products or features that users love
   

  

* Enterprise software with AI capabilities built in (not tacked on)
* Products that required deep LLM integration and cost optimization
* Cross\-functional initiatives that span multiple teams or product areas
* Experiences that balance power with usability.


 Core capabilities
   

  

* AI fluency, not just enthusiasm – You understand LLM capabilities and limits. You know the difference between a prototype and a production system. You think about cost, latency, hallucination, and compliance from day one.
* Systems thinking across pillars – You see how an AI feature in one pillar impacts the others. You optimize for platform coherence, not local feature wins.
* Customer reality grounding – You spend time with users and understand their AI skepticism. You don't oversell; you deliver reliably.
* Quality obsession – You know that "enterprise grade" is non\-negotiable. Explainability, compliance, reliability, and safety are as important as feature velocity.
* Technical depth without being an engineer – You read research, understand prompt engineering tradeoffs, can discuss model selection and fine\-tuning. You think rigorously about technical problems.


 Nice to have
   

  

* Shipped copilot or AI\-assisted features in a production SaaS product
* Experience with LLM cost optimization, latency budgeting, or inference infrastructure
* Familiarity with enterprise workflow, process automation, or BPM domains
* Track record of shipping cross\-functional initiatives with competing stakeholders

jobs.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------


In the Worldwide Returns \& ReCommerce (WW R\&R) group at Amazon, we are dedicated to ‘making zero happen’ – zero cost of returns, zero waste, and zero defects – to benefit our customers, company, and environment. We are an agile and inclusive organization that constantly innovates to create long\-term value by investing in our people and our planet, not simply focusing on the bottom line.  

  

WW R\&R includes business, product, operations, data, and software engineering teams, who together manage the lifecycle of returned and damaged products. In WW R\&R, you will partner across these teams to help customers get the most value out of Amazon’s products; improve the customer returns experience; and reduce defects, waste, and cost in reverse logistics processes. You will be a leader, a builder, and an owner, collaborating cross\-functionally with technical, operations, and business teams to design scalable and automated solutions to customer problems.  

  

Refunds Experience is a charter of WW R\&R that is dedicated to providing the best\-in\-class refunds experience to customers, by prioritizing faster refunds and ensuring 100% completeness. We strive to build a strong enforcement function to preserve CX, mitigate risk \& avoid policy abuse.  

  

We are looking for a seasoned Program Leader who has a passion for working in cross\-functional environments, strong communication skills (verbal \& written) in addition to proven program management experience. Join us if you want the opportunity to make a big impact in a quickly growing team that can make a big difference in the customers' journey with Amazon.  

  

Amazon is Earth’s most customer\-centric company and in WW R\&R, the Earth is our customer too. Come join us and innovate with the Amazon Worldwide Returns \& ReCommerce.  

  

Key job responsibilities  

In this role, you will:  

Create vision, disambiguate complex problem spaces, roadmap, and execution across a suite of refund programs to improve customer trust  

Develop worldwide mechanisms with huge customer\-facing and financial impact  

Be a leader, required to collaborate cross\-functionally with technical, operations, and business retail teams to design comprehensive, scalable and automated solutions to fulfil the returns policies customers avail and preserve CX.  

  

A day in the life  

You will work with a team of high performing Product/Program Managers, tech counter part on planning and prioritization of product roadmap. You understand the systems and technologies behind your product, their limitations, boundary conditions, and reasons for architectural decisions. You are capable of articulating when a new solution is needed (and when it is not) or discuss the differences between two competing solutions. You proactively mitigate risks and help reduce a program's exposure to failure modes.  

  

About the team  

WW Refunds CX team under the broader WW Returns CX (WW RCX) sub\-org, plays a critical role in the overall Worldwide Returns \& ReCommerce (WW R\&R) org by ensuring customers are provided timely and complete refunds. To address this area of paramount importance, we partner with multiple orgs outside WWRR, primarily CS, Ordering, Payments, and internally with Tech \& Data Engineering to ensure faster refunds and 100% refund completion across a varying breadth of diverse use\-cases and geographies. This IC role serves as a central orchestrator within this strategic workstream, responsible for designing and prioritizing optimal product investments while coordinating end\-to\-end execution.

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* 5\+ years of program or project management experience
* Experience using data and metrics to determine and drive improvements
* Experience owning program strategy, end to end delivery, and communicating results to senior leadership
* Experience working cross functionally with tech and non\-tech teams
* Experience in Reverse Logistics, transportation and/or retail operations
* Basic comfort with Gen AI tools, SQL query and data analysis
* Communicate effectively with technology teams
* Master's degree, or MBA in business, operations, science or related field

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* 2\+ years of driving process improvements experience
* Master's degree, or MBA in business, operations, human resources, adult education, organizational development, instructional design or related field

  

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how\-we\-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

**About Us**
 Zelis is modernizing the healthcare financial experience in the United States (U.S.) across payers, providers, and healthcare consumers. We serve more than 750 payers, including the top five national health plans, regional health plans, TPAs and millions of healthcare providers and consumers across our platform of solutions. Zelis sees across the system to identify, optimize, and solve problems holistically with technology built by healthcare experts – driving real, measurable results for clients.
   

  

 At Zelis, AI is woven into the fabric of how we work. Every associate is expected \- and empowered \- to partner with AI to challenge the status quo, accelerate innovation, and amplify their impact. This is a place for builders with a growth mindset who act with agility, embrace change, and use modern technology to shape smarter solutions, exceptional experiences, and the future of our industry for our clients, customers, and our culture.
   

  

**Why We Do What We Do**
 In the U.S., consumers, payers, and providers face significant challenges throughout the healthcare financial journey. Zelis helps streamline the process by offering solutions that improve transparency, efficiency, and communication among all parties involved. By addressing the obstacles that patients face in accessing care, navigating the intricacies of insurance claims, and the logistical challenges healthcare providers encounter with processing payments, Zelis aims to create a more seamless and effective healthcare financial system.
   

  

 Zelis India plays a crucial role in this mission by supporting various initiatives that enhance the healthcare financial experience. The local team contributes to the development and implementation of innovative solutions, ensuring that technology and processes are optimized for efficiency and effectiveness. Beyond operational expertise, Zelis India cultivates a collaborative work culture, leadership development, and global exposure, creating a dynamic environment for professional growth. With hybrid work flexibility, comprehensive healthcare benefits, financial wellness programs, and cultural celebrations, we foster a holistic workplace experience. Additionally, the team plays a vital role in maintaining high standards of service delivery and contributes to Zelis’ award\-winning culture.

* Value Delivery: Assess business value, create cases, and prioritize epics, stories, and themes to maximize impact.
* Release Management: Drive product release planning, set delivery expectations, and ensure timely rollout of new functionalities.

* Strong knowledge of U.S. healthcare domain, including members, providers, networks, claims, payments, EDI transactions, and HIPAA compliance.
* Proven ability to manage dynamic healthcare products that evolve through continuous refinements and member feedback.
* In‑depth expertise in product management and agile methodologies (Scrum, SAFe).

* Experience in collaborating with diverse technical development and QA teams.
* Exceptional communication, presentation, and leadership skills.
* Skilled at balancing and managing conflicting stakeholder priorities.

* Bachelor’s degree (or equivalent) in healthcare, technology, or related discipline.

* SAFe POPM certification (or equivalent).

Role Summary
   

  

 The Business Analyst (BA) for the Alpha Index HUB (AIH) is a key contributor within the Product Organization, responsible for translating business, operational, and client needs into clear, actionable product requirements. The role supports the design, build, testing, and rollout of scalable index and benchmark data capabilities that are critical to Alpha’s data platform.
   

  

 This position works closely with Product Owners, Engineering, Quality Assurance (QA), Operations, and third‑party data vendors to ensure product enhancements are well‑defined, operable, auditable, and aligned with Alpha product strategy and delivery standards.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

 Product \& Requirements Management
   

  

* Partner with Product Owners to define, document, and refine product requirements aligned with Alpha Index HUB strategy and roadmap.
* Lead requirements elicitation through stakeholder interviews, workflow analysis, and data analysis.
* Produce high‑quality artifacts including Business Requirements Documents (BRDs), functional and non‑functional requirements, user stories, and acceptance criteria.
* Ensure requirements are clear, testable, and traceable through development and testing phases.


 Stakeholder Engagement \& Collaboration
   

  

* Act as the primary liaison between Product, Engineering, QA, Operations, and external vendors.
* Facilitate discussions to ensure shared understanding of scope, dependencies, risks, and expected outcomes.
* Work closely with Operations teams to incorporate operational workflows, controls, and exception handling into product requirements.


 Delivery \& Execution Support
   

  

* Support Agile delivery activities including backlog refinement, sprint planning, and sprint reviews.
* Define detailed acceptance criteria, covering positive, negative, and edge‑case scenarios, to enable effective QA and UAT/CUAT execution.
* Participate in testing activities and support validation of delivered functionality against business intent.


 Operational Readiness \& Risk Management
   

  

* Ensure product requirements address data quality, auditability, operational transparency, and control considerations.
* Contribute to the definition of dashboards, status indicators, and monitoring frameworks that support daily operational validation and issue detection.
* Assist with documentation and communication of field definitions, status meanings, and operational behaviors to reduce ambiguity and risk.


 Continuous Improvement
   

  

* Identify opportunities to simplify workflows, enhance usability, and improve operational efficiency.
* Support ongoing evolution and maturity of Alpha Index HUB capabilities in alignment with broader Alpha product and platform initiatives.


**Experience**
 Required Qualifications
   

  

* 12\+ years of experience as a Business Analyst, with level determined by role (BA, BA II, Senior BA).
* Experience working in a product‑led or Agile/Scrum delivery environment.
* Proven experience producing BRDs, user stories, and acceptance criteria.


 Skills \& Competencies
   

  

* Strong analytical and problem‑solving skills with high attention to detail.
* Ability to translate complex technical and data concepts into clear business requirements.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to tailor messaging to both technical and non‑technical audiences.
* Effective stakeholder management and collaboration skills.
* Hands‑on experience writing and reviewing SQL queries to support data analysis, validation, and issue investigation.
* Working knowledge of running, monitoring, and validating processes in the Charles River Development (CRD) environment, including awareness of upstream/downstream dependencies, batch processing, and operational workflows.


**Preferred Domain Knowledge**
* Experience with financial services, index, benchmark, or market data platforms.
* Familiarity with large‑scale data pipelines, dashboards, or operational monitoring tools.
* Understanding of data governance, controls, and audit considerations.


 Reporting \& Alignment
   

  

* Reports into the Alpha Product Organization.
* Works in close partnership with Alpha Index HUB Product Owners, Engineering leads, QA teams, and Operations stakeholders.
* Embedded within product delivery cadence, including sprint planning, refinement, and release activities.


 Measures of Success
   

  

* Requirements are clearly defined, consistently understood, and require minimal rework.
* Engineering and QA teams can deliver features efficiently with reduced clarification cycles.
* Operations teams gain improved visibility, consistency, and confidence in Alpha Index HUB processing.
* Product enhancements materially improve platform reliability, transparency, and scalability.

jobs.title: Sr. Data & AI Analyst
jobs.description:
At Bristol Myers Squibb, our employees often ask, “Who are you working for?”—a question that fuels collaboration, accountability, and urgency in our work. Our purpose\-driven culture inspires us to discover, develop, and deliver innovative medicines to prevail over serious diseases. We offer uniquely interesting and meaningful work, opportunities for growth, and a supportive environment that values inclusion, wellbeing, flexibility, and comprehensive benefits. This is work that transforms the lives of patients, and the careers of those who do it.  



  

**Position Summary**

The Data \& AI Architect designs and builds the AI\-ready context layer that translates Commercial business knowledge, domain rules, and data into structured, governed context that both people and AI agents can reliably act on. This role owns the design of ontological models, taxonomy frameworks, business glossaries, metadata management practices, and business/AI context layers, and the semantic governance processes that keep them current — enabling consistent interpretation of Commercial data and business logic across Sales, Marketing, Market Access, Medical Affairs, Regulatory Affairs, Finance, Analytics, AI/ML Ops, and data product teams. The role owns the Commercial semantic and context layer, partnering with Enterprise IT to build and extend it within the platforms and standards Enterprise IT defines. As Commercial increasingly relies on AI agents and copilots to reason over Commercial data, this role is directly responsible for ensuring those agents are grounded in accurate, governed, and up\-to\-date business context.  



**Key Responsibilities**

* Design, build, and govern the Commercial semantic and AI context layer in partnership with the Commercial Data Architects and Enterprise IT, translating Commercial business knowledge, processes, and data into structured context that underpins consistent interpretation by both people and AI agents across Sales, Marketing, Market Access, Medical Affairs, Regulatory Affairs, Finance, Analytics, and data product teams.
* Develop and maintain ontological models that represent Commercial domain knowledge structures, including products, stakeholders, channels, outcomes, metrics, business events, and their interrelationships, enabling consistent reasoning across systems, analytical platforms, data products, and AI\-enabled solutions.
* Design and maintain taxonomy frameworks and classification structures for Commercial content, data assets, business processes, domains, entities, and use cases, enabling reliable search, segmentation, reporting, reuse, and alignment with pharma commercial operations.
* Build, maintain, and govern the Commercial business glossary, ensuring critical business terms, commercial KPIs, data definitions, business rules, calculations, and regulatory concepts are clearly defined, consistently used, and aligned with approved business meaning.
* Establish and apply metadata management practices for Commercial data assets, including ownership, stewardship, source system, refresh frequency, sensitivity classification, lineage, quality expectations, access considerations, and usage restrictions.
* Translate business rules, metric definitions, KPIs, and domain knowledge into the structured context — knowledge graphs, retrieval\-grounding documents, and tool/function schemas — that AI agents and copilots consume, ensuring agent outputs stay grounded in approved Commercial business meaning.
* Partner with the AI/ML Ops team to define how agents access, retrieve, and reason over Commercial context, and to design evaluation approaches that catch ungrounded or inaccurate agent outputs before they reach business users.
* Own context quality, freshness, and drift management as agentic AI use scales across Commercial data products, proactively identifying where business change has outpaced the context layer.
* Architect and maintain the business/AI context layer that translates technical Commercial data structures into business\-ready, context\-enriched representations consumed by self\-service analytics, consistent reporting, data products, and AI agents — designing for reuse across the Commercial organization rather than one\-off, single\-purpose context.
* Maintain semantic mappings between business concepts, glossary terms, data models, source systems, data products, reports, and AI context assets to improve traceability, discoverability, reuse, and impact analysis across the Commercial data ecosystem.
* Operate semantic governance processes for ontologies, taxonomies, glossaries, metadata standards, context assets, and semantic mappings, ensuring changes are reviewed, documented, versioned, auditable, and aligned with enterprise data governance expectations.
* Partner with data architects, data engineers, product owners, analysts, governance teams, privacy/compliance partners, and business stakeholders to validate definitions, resolve semantic ambiguity, and ensure context assets reflect approved Commercial business meaning.

Ensure compliance\-aware documentation and governance practices by confirming semantic and AI context assets reflect applicable privacy, data use, auditability, access control, and pharma regulatory considerations in a regulated life sciences environment.  

* 

  

We hire for skills and capabilities, not just credentials – if this role excites you, but doesn’t perfectly match your resume, we encourage you to apply anyway.

Where you work matters – because collaboration, innovation and patient impact happen in many settings. Our roles are structured across four work models: site\-essential, site\-by\-design, field\-based and remote\-by\-design. The model assigned to this role is based on its core responsibilities. As the **Business Analyst – eCommerce**, you will play a key role in driving solution\-oriented changes across the Commercial Department and improving the overall efficiency of the eCommerce domain. You will be responsible for researching, analyzing, and developing data\-driven business cases that support process optimization, cost reduction, new business opportunities, and strategic improvements.

  

You will work closely with the Manager Commercial Projects, Lead Product Owner, Project Managers, Product Owners, and cross\-functional teams including Marketing, Content, B2B, Sales Channels, and Customer Service. You will translate business needs and opportunities into well\-defined business cases, including scope, solution options, expected impact, resource requirements, and budget considerations, enabling effective decision\-making and implementation.

 **You will:**

* **Business Case Development:** Research, analyze, and prepare solution\-oriented business cases for new initiatives, process improvements, eCommerce enhancements, and strategic changes.
* **eCommerce Optimization:** Identify opportunities to improve eCommerce efficiency through process optimization, cost reduction, technology enhancements, and identification of new business opportunities.
* **Market \& Competitor Research:** Conduct market research using available tools and resources to assess new features, industry trends, emerging technologies, and competitor approaches.
* **Data Analysis:** Gather and analyze relevant business and operational data to identify trends, opportunities, challenges, and potential solutions that support informed decision\-making.
* **Solution Identification:** Evaluate existing eCommerce technology platforms, applications, and emerging technologies to determine potential solutions and expected business outcomes.
* **Innovative Solutions:** Develop innovative solutions for operational and strategic improvements and identify the processes, systems, and capabilities required to implement proposed changes.
* **Requirements Management:** Work closely with business stakeholders and cross\-functional teams to understand, document, analyze, and validate critical business requirements.

jobs.description:
At Curriculum Associates, we believe in the potential of every child and are changing the face of education technology with award\-winning learning programs like i\-Ready that serve a third of the nation’s K–8 students. For more than 50 years, our commitment to making classrooms better places, serving educators, and supporting accessible learning experiences for all students has driven the continuous improvement of our innovative programs. Our team of more than 2,500 employees is composed of lifelong learners who stand behind this mission, working tirelessly to serve the educational community with world\-class programs and support every day.

**About the Role**


As Senior Technical Technical Product Manager – I, you’ll be the anchor of our product development engine driving day\-to\-day execution with the technical judgment and systems perspective to see how each decision ripples across the broader platform.


This role pairs hands\-on delivery ownership with real product and technical thinking. You’ll keep the backlog sharp, the team unblocked, and the product built right while assessing how changes in one system affect the products, teams, and workflows connected to it.


If you get energy from owning the details and thinking several systems ahead at the same time, this role is built for you. Bonus if you bring EdTech context and empathy for learners and educators.


What You’ll Do


As a Senior Product Manager, you’ll make execution your superpower while shaping product direction and protecting the wider ecosystem:

* **Own the Backlog:** Maintain a healthy, prioritized, and well\-groomed backlog. Ensure stories are ready, refined, and aligned with sprint goals.
* **Write User Stories \& Acceptance Criteria:** Translate feature requests and product ideas into clear, testable stories with robust acceptance criteria and edge cases.
* **Assess Cross\-System Impact:** Evaluate how a change in one product, workflow, or integration could ripple across connected systems, teams, or compliance obligations and flag downstream risk before it surfaces.
* **Drive Day\-to\-Day Execution:** Lead sprint ceremonies: stand\-ups, planning, retros and proactively remove blockers. Partner with the Engineering and Agile Coaches to keep momentum high.

* **Support Roadmap \& Discovery:** Contribute to roadmap discussions, customer discovery, and impact analysis.

* **Support Go\-to\-Market \& Enablement:** Contribute to go\-to\-market activities, internal enablement, and release documentation as required.
* **Connect Execution to Outcomes:** Tie daily delivery work back to broader business and student/educator outcomes.
* **Champion Iterative Delivery:** Ensure value ships early and often, adjusting based on user and stakeholder feedback.


What You’ll Bring


You’re hands\-on, high\-ownership, and wired for structured execution with the technical curiosity to understand how the pieces fit together. You have a bias for action, a passion for clarity, and comfort operating inside a complex, interconnected product ecosystem.


Key Skills \& Abilities

* **Systems \& Ecosystem Thinking:** Able to anticipate how a change in one product or workflow affects connected systems, teams, and compliance obligations — and plan around that impact before it becomes a problem.
* **AI Fluency \& Applied Thinking:** Skilled at using AI tools in daily product work including evaluating and stress\-testing potential solutions and accelerating documentation or requirements engineering with the judgment to know where AI genuinely adds value.
* **Strong Execution Leadership:** Proven ability to drive sprint success, align teams, and deliver quality under deadlines.
* **Backlog Ownership:** Comfortable managing and refining complex backlogs across multiple workstreams.
* **Cross\-Functional Prioritization:** Skilled at making and defending prioritization trade\-offs with engineering, UX, and business stakeholders, especially under competing regulatory and customer pressures.
* **Competitive \& Market Research:** Able to research competitor products and market trends to sharpen prioritization, positioning, and roadmap decisions.
* **Detail\-Oriented Story Writing:** Able to write stories and acceptance criteria that engineers can confidently build, test, and validate against.

AppViewX is the only machine and agent identity security company built for the AI and quantum era, bringing together discovery, automation, control, and intelligence. The AVX Platform helps enterprises reduce risk by providing complete visibility and governance over every machine and AI agent identity, automating their lifecycle, controlling their access, and proving compliance at the speed business demands. Trusted by global enterprises across financial services, healthcare, and technology, AppViewX is recognized as a leader in the IDC 2026 MarketScape for Certificate Lifecycle Management and KuppingerCole’s 2025 Non\-Human Identity Management Leadership Compass. For more information, users can visit appviewx.com.
 



**Our Values** 




 Our values define how we work, make decisions, and deliver for our customers and each other. Some reflect strengths deeply engrained in how we work. Others represent the standards we are committed to building together.
 


* **We Do What We Say:** 
 We own our commitments, communicate honestly about progress, and measure success by results, not activity.
* **We Are Trusted Experts:** 
 We continuously build our expertise, offer candid guidance, and focus on the outcomes our customers and colleagues need.
* **We Raise the Bar:** 
 We stay curious, challenge the status quo, take smart risks, and turn better ideas into meaningful results.
* **We Win Together:** 
 We share information, debate openly, commit together, and recognize that our success is connected to the success of our customers and teammates.



 If these values reflect how you want to work and contribute, you will find an opportunity to make a meaningful impact at AppViewX.
 



 Role Overview
 



 We are looking for a Principal Product Manager to work with the Director of Product and help set the strategic direction for our Certificate Lifecycle Management (CLM) product line. This is a senior, high\-impact individual contributor role: you will own the planning and execution for CLM, help shape company\-level bets on where crypto\-agility and CLM automation are headed, and act as the most senior product voice across a portfolio of related modules and initiatives.
 



 You will operate with significant autonomy, partnering directly with engineering leadership, design, sales, and executive stakeholders to translate market and regulatory shifts into a coherent, differentiated roadmap. You will also raise the bar for the broader product organization, mentoring senior and mid\-level PMs, setting standards for discovery and requirements gathering, and representing AppViewX’s CLM strategy with customers, and industry forums.
 



 You bring deep product instincts, sharp executive and customer communication, and strong technical fluency in PKI and certificate management. You are comfortable operating ambiguously at the strategy layer while still being able to go deep into requirements, architecture trade\-offs, and cross\-functional execution when it matters most.
 



 Key Responsibilities:
 


* Own the roadmap for Certificate Lifecycle Management (CLM), aligning it with company strategy, market opportunity, competitive dynamics, and enterprise customer needs.
* Act as the senior product strategist for CLM, setting priorities across multiple modules and workstreams and ensuring coherence across the broader product portfolio.
* Lead deep discovery engagements with enterprise customers, PKI architects, and customer stakeholders to surface strategic pain points around certificate issuance, renewal, revocation, discovery, and visibility.
* Translate complex regulatory and compliance requirements (e.g., NIST, PCI\-DSS, SOC 2, eIDAS, FIPS 140\-2\) into a coherent, forward\-looking set of product capabilities and standards.
* Define AppViewX’s point of view and product response to major industry shifts, including post\-quantum cryptography (PQC), short\-lived certificates (47\-day validity), and Zero Trust models, working closely with engineering and architecture teams.
* Set the bar for product requirements quality across the team, writing and reviewing PRDs, user stories, and acceptance criteria for the most complex, ambiguous, or cross\-cutting initiatives.
* Mentor and coach senior and mid\-level PMs, contributing to hiring, onboarding, and the overall maturity of product practices, documentation, and process across the organization.
* Collaborate closely with Design on the end\-to\-end experience for certificate discovery, enrollment, renewal automation, and policy enforcement, ensuring consistency across a growing product portfolio.
* Represent AppViewX’s CLM product strategy and roadmap externally with key customers, prospects, and at conferences or forums as needed.
* Influence without direct authority across engineering, design, marketing, sales, and technical field teams aligning diverse stakeholders from individual contributors to the C\-suite around a shared strategic direction.



 Required Qualifications:
 


* 10\+ years of product management experience, including at least 4\+ years operating at a senior/lead or principal level owning strategy for a B2B SaaS or enterprise software product.
* Demonstrated track record of owning product strategy end\-to\-end, from market analysis and vision\-setting through execution, launch, and iteration at scale.
* Strong analytical and data\-driven decision\-making skills; experienced with product analytics, cohort analysis, A/B testing, and using data to inform multi\-quarter strategic bets.
* Exceptional written and verbal communication; able to influence senior executives and align cross\-functional stakeholders spanning engineering, design, technical sales, and leadership.
* Significant experience working with enterprise customers in regulated industries (finance, healthcare, government, telecoms), including direct engagement with security and compliance stakeholders.
* Proven experience managing complex, API\-first products and platform\-level in…

jobs.title: Product Manager II
jobs.description:
**About Neo** 




 AI is the most significant shift in how work gets done since the advent of the Internet — yet most organizations fail to capture its value.
 **Neo** 
 is changing that.
 



 Founded by
 **Bhavin Turakhia**
 — Co\-Founder of
 
 Zeta
 
 ,
 
 Radix
 
 , and
 
 Titan
 
 —
 **Neo** 
 is building an integrated, AI\-first suite of products that capture work, centralize context, and make AI a first\-class participant in every workflow:
 


* **Tasket** 
 — A radically reimagined, AI\-native, work management platform that centralizes context and makes AI delegation seamless for all work.
* **Friday** 
 — AI Assistant, co\-worker and agent platform, pre\-integrated into Tasket, Studio, Drive and 1000\+ SaaS platforms.
* **Studio** 
 — AI\-native suite for co\-creating docs, spreadsheets and diagrams collaboratively with humans and agents.
* **Drive** 
 — AI\-native repository, where humans and agents can co\-work on files.
* **Scribe** 
 — AI assistant for meetings that goes beyond note\-taking and actually does your work while on the call.



  





**About the role** 




 As a part of Product Management team, you will work with a team of other Product Managers, Designers and Analysts driving the execution of various zero to 1 Products. We are proponents of leveraging best in breed AI tools in every step of the Product Development lifecycle \- Strategy, UX, Development and Testing. This requires a very different product development mindset comprising a lean team, of senior resources, that are hands\-on and AI adept, resulting in ultra\-rapid iteration cycles and fast output. You will experience this unique approach to the product development lifecycle, from ideation to launch to success.
 



  





**Job Location** 



* Bangalore, India (100% on\-site)



  





**Responsibilities** 




**1\. Product Management** 



* Meticulously drive each feature from ideation, implementation, go live and adoption



**2\. User interview \& research** 



* Lead continuous user discovery through interviews, contextual inquiry and surveys to understand workflows, pain points, and decision criteria.
* Synthesize qualitative \+ quantitative insights into clear problem statements, personas/JTBD, journey maps, and prioritized opportunity areas.



**3\. Growth Hacking** 



* Measure Output metrics (Acquisition, Activation, Retention, Engagement) and Input metrics (Conversion Funnels, Engagement) that matter
* Leverage Product Analytics Platforms (Mixpanel, Amplitude etc), Data Analytics Platforms (Metabase, Superset)
* Creative Feature Ideation to come up with Features that have maximum impact on the metrics that matter
* Leverage frameworks for Feature Prioritization



**4\. UX** 



* Drive the creation of delightful, intuitive and engaging user interfaces in collaboration with UX designers to drive user adoption and NPS



**5\. Forward deployment \& adoption (hands\-on)** 



* Act as a forward\-deployed PM to ensure successful customer implementation and adoption, embedded with teams to unblock integration, workflow changes, and rollout.
* Develop adoption playbooks: onboarding flows, enablement content, rollout checklists, admin guides, and best\-practice templates.



  





**Skills** 



* In depth understanding and knowledge of Statistics, Analytics, Business Intelligence, SQL, Product Analytics platforms
* Ability to interpret complex data sets and derive actionable insights
* In depth understanding and knowledge of technology platforms and their capabilities for Web and Mobile development
* Keen eye for design and aesthetics
* Excellent UX and copywriting skills
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills
* Experience in conducting user research
* Meticulous in program management processes



  





**Experience \& Qualifications** 



* 3 to 6 years in Product Management.
* Experience in AI\-native companies, startups, founding teams, or as a founder is preferred
* Software engineering/technical background

jobs.title: Product Manager II
jobs.description:
**Level Up Your Career with Zynga!**
 At Zynga, we bring people together through the power of play. As a global leader in interactive entertainment and a proud label of Take\-Two Interactive, our games have been downloaded over 6 billion times—connecting players in 175\+ countries through fun, strategy, and a little friendly competition.
   

  

 From thrilling casino spins to epic strategy battles, mind\-bending puzzles, and social word challenges, our diverse game portfolio has something for everyone. Fan\-favorites and latest hits include FarmVille™, Words With Friends™, Zynga Poker™, Game of Thrones Slots Casino™, Wizard of Oz Slots™, Hit it Rich! Slots™, Wonka Slots™, Top Eleven™, Toon Blast™, Empires \& Puzzles™, Merge Dragons!™, CSR Racing™, Harry Potter: Puzzles \& Spells™, Match Factory™, and Color Block Jam™—plus many more!
   

  

 Founded in 2007 and headquartered in California, our teams span North America, Europe, and Asia, working together to craft unforgettable gaming experiences. Whether you're spinning, strategizing, matching, or competing, Zynga is where fun meets innovation—and where you can take your career to the next level.
   

  

 Join us and be part of the play!
   

  

**Position Overview**
 Zynga India is looking for an experienced Product Manager with demonstrated success in mobile and/or consumer products to join the team and help connect the world through PLAY.
   

  

 As a hardworking and ambitious product leader, you will innovate and execute on product initiatives that will bring surprise and delight to our players while delivering business value to the company.
   

  

 You will use a combination of excellent analytical abilities, business discernment, and critical thinking to innovate and build extraordinary experiences that will impact our players’ lives. The Product Manager will have a consistent record of owning and delivering experiences to customers that raise\-the\-bar from an innovation, usability, and design perspective. You will need to thrive and deliver results in a fast\-paced and dynamic environment.
   

  

**What You'll Do**
* Responsible for the full product/game lifecycle, from writing specifications, working across multi\-disciplinary teams: design, art, and engineering to launch core features within our existing and new games!
* Exhibit sound product discernment, ability to formulate product strategy and present clear measurable objectives that will lead to achieving our business goals.
* Expected to provide valuable input into business cases based on in\-depth data analysis and demonstrate how that analysis impacts key product metrics.
* Run prioritization and trade\-offs among customer experience, technical constraints and business drivers.
* Expected to develop a deep understanding of our users: their problems, their needs, their desires


**What You Bring**
* 4\+ years of experience in product management in consumer/mobile or game development is preferred but not required
* Focus on outcomes with shown experience making product teams successful
* Ability to communicate across diverse cultures, languages, work styles, and personalities
* Ability to create wire\-frames, product specifications and white papers
* Strong project management skills and ability to present work to executive staff
* Willingness to roll up your sleeves and do whatever it takes to help your team win
* Extraordinary data analysis skills
* Experience with multivariate testing and experimentation
* Strong passion for games and creating fun, compelling and addictive user experiences
* Outstanding written/oral, organizational, analytical abilities, and attention to detail
* You be a self\-starter, a teammate and driven
* Previous start\-up, social networking and/or consulting experience is a strong plus.


**What We Offer You**
 Zynga offers a world\-class benefits package that helps support and balance the needs of our teams. To find out more about our benefits, visit the Zynga Benefits
   

  

 We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer, which means we are committed to creating and celebrating diverse thoughts, cultures, and backgrounds throughout our organization. Employment with us is based on substantive ability, objective qualifications, and work ethic – not an individual’s race, creed, color, religion, sex or gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin or ancestry, alienage or citizenship status, physical or mental disability, pregnancy, age, genetic information, veteran status, marital status, status as a victim of domestic violence or sex offenses, reproductive health decision, or any other characteristics protected by applicable law.
   

  

 As an equal opportunity employer, we are committed to providing the necessary support and accommodation to qualified individuals with disabilities, health conditions, or impairments (subject to any local qualifying requirements) to ensure their full participation in the job application or interview process. Please contact us at accommodationrequest@zynga.com to request any accommodations or for support related to your application for an open position.
   

  

 Please be aware that Zynga does not conduct job interviews or make job offers over third\-party messaging apps such as Telegram, WhatsApp, or others. Zynga also does not engage in any financial exchanges during the recruitment or onboarding process, and will never ask a candidate for their personal or financial information over an app or other unofficial chat channel. Any attempt to do so may be the result of a scamp or phishing attack, and you should not engage. Zynga’s in\-house recruitment team will only contact individuals through their official Company email addresses (i.e., via a zynga.com, take2games.com, naturalmotion.com, smallgiantgames.com, themavens.com, gram.gs email domain).

jobs.title: Staff Product Manager - Continuous Deployment
jobs.description:
Harness is the AI Software Delivery Platform company, led by technologist and entrepreneur Jyoti Bansal (founder of AppDynamics, acquired by Cisco for $3\.7B). Harness has raised approximately $570M in funding and is valued at $5\.5B, backed by leading investors including Goldman Sachs, Menlo Ventures, IVP, Unusual Ventures, Citi Ventures, and more. As AI accelerates code creation, the real bottleneck has shifted to everything after the code – testing, deployments, application security, reliability, compliance, and cost optimization. Harness brings AI and automation to this “outer loop,” helping teams ship software faster while maintaining security and governance throughout the entire software delivery lifecycle.
   

  

 Powered by Harness AI and the Software Delivery Knowledge Graph, the Harness Platform applies deep context and intelligent automation across the software delivery lifecycle with governance and policy\-driven controls embedded throughout the platform.
   

  

 Over the past year, Harness powered over 185M deployments, 82M builds, 18T flag evaluations, 8M security scans, 9\.1B optimized tests, 3T protected API calls, and helped manage $2\.8B in cloud spend — enabling customers like United Airlines, Morningstar, and Choice Hotels to accelerate releases by up to 75%, reduce cloud costs by up to 60%, and achieve 10x DevOps efficiency.
   

  

 With a global team across 26 offices and 27 countries, Harness is shaping the future of AI software delivery — and we’re looking for exceptional talent to help us move even faster.
   

  

**Position Summary**
 Harness is seeking a Staff product manager to drive the definition, development, and adoption of our packaged and shipped product \- Harness Continuous Deployment.
   

  

* In this role, you will be owning core areas of Database Deployments \& few other deployment types in Harness Continuous Deployment.
* You will own technical, end\-to\-end product initiatives—from identifying user needs and defining requirements to working across several teams to ensure successful delivery.
* You’ll work closely with customers and engineering teams to improve product adoption, guide product development, ensure technical feasibility and high\-quality execution, and find innovative ways to efficiently solve complex developer experience challenges.


 This is a high\-impact, high\-visibility role that requires technical depth and effective cross\-functional execution spanning Engineering, Sales, Marketing, UX, Research, Customer Success and Support.
   

  

**About The Role**
* Own a product area of Continuous Deployment roadmap end\-to\-end — from progressive delivery (canary, blue\-green, rolling), automated rollback, and GitOps workflows to deployment verification
* Translate customer deployment pain — risky releases, slow rollbacks, fragmented pipeline visibility — into detailed product requirements
* Partner daily with engineering and design to validate technical feasibility and ship high\-quality features on predictable timelines.
* Work directly with platform and DevOps engineers at customers like United Airlines, Morningstar, and Choice Hotels to gather requirements and pressure\-test the roadmap.
* Write and manage detailed technical product requirements and specifications
* Collaborate closely with engineering,design team to ensure technical feasibility and the timely delivery of high\-quality features
* Engage with customers, developers, and internal stakeholders to gather requirements, address pain points, and drive continuous product improvement
* Define product roadmap for the area owned by identifying and prioritizing new features and improvements based on customer feedback, technical considerations, market trends, and business goals
* Collaborate cross\-functionally with Developer Relations, Marketing, and other teams to create both internal enablement resources and external content that drive adoption and educate users on new features and capabilities


**About You**
* Bachelors in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent experience is required
* 7\+ years of experience in product management with enterprise SaaS / Cloud companies
* 5\+ years of experience managing technical products and delivering solutions that enhance developer experience and productivity.
* You can operate in a dynamic environment, and are able to adapt quickly
* You are technically strong and are able to understand architecture, engineering decisions, and can work closely with developers to ensure high\-quality implementation.
* You are customer focused and passionate about solving real\-world developer challenges
* Strong analytical skills and data\-driven product decision\-making mindset
* Strong communication skills, verbal and written
* A strong background in cloud\-native infrastructure (AWS, GCP, Azure), containerization, CI/CD pipelines, and Infrastructure as Code (IaC) tools like Terraform, CloudFormation, or Ansible, SQL/NoSQL, Liquibase/Flyway, Database Engines. A computer science degree or past software engineering experience is highly valued here.
* Git,, Kubernetes, OPA, Terraform/OpenTofu
* Prior experience as a software developer and/or Startup experience is a big plus
* Experience leading cross functional teams


**What You Will Have At Harness**
* Competitive salary
* Comprehensive healthcare benefits
* Flexible Spending Account (FSA)
* Flexible work schedule
* Employee Assistance Program (EAP)
* Flexible Time Off and Parental Leave
* Monthly, quarterly, and annual social and team building events
* Monthly internet reimbursement

* Accelerating Our Mission to Bring AI to Everything After Code

jobs.title: Product Manager, Patient Messaging
jobs.description:
Join us as we work to create a thriving ecosystem that delivers accessible, high\-quality, and sustainable healthcare for all.
   

  

**Position Summary**
 Join athenahealth's Patient Experience (PEX) division as a Product Manager for the Patient Messaging Zone in Bangalore. In this role, you will own a defined product area within Patient Messaging, driving the roadmap for AI\-enabled communication capabilities that help patients and care teams connect efficiently and safely. You will work closely with engineering, data science, UX, and analytics teams to deliver messaging experiences that are usable, trustworthy, and grounded in responsible use of AI. This role partners closely with US\-based product peers and reports to the Zone's product leadership in Bangalore.
   

  

**About The Team**
 The Patient Messaging Zone brings together Product Management, Engineering, UX, Product Analytics, Data Science, and Patient Safety partners to improve how patients and provider staff communicate. The team is expanding its use of AI to reduce staff burden while keeping patients safe and informed. This role will help shape product decisions for an assigned area within that portfolio, working in close partnership with the Bangalore development organization and US stakeholders.
   

  

**Essential Job Responsibilities**
**Product Strategy \& AI\-Enabled Delivery**
* Define and manage the product strategy and roadmap for an assigned area within Patient Messaging.
* Learn users' workflows (patients, front\-desk/clinical staff) and propose AI\-enabled solutions that reduce friction and improve response times.
* Collaborate with data science and engineering to shape AI features ensuring they are measurable and appropriate for patient\-facing communication.
* Define expected behavior for AI\-enabled capabilities, including guardrails for trust, explainability, escalation to a human, and handling of low\-confidence outputs.
* Write clear user stories, acceptance criteria, and product requirements that support engineering delivery, including requirements specific to model behavior, edge cases, and fallback paths.
* Use AI\-enabled tools and product analytics to inform requirements, evaluate tradeoffs, and speed up decision\-making across planning and delivery.


**Cross\-Functional Execution**
* Work with engineering and scrum teams to prioritize backlog items and guide day\-to\-day delivery in an Agile environment.
* Partner with cross\-functional teams to evaluate customer needs, market trends, and competitive signals relevant to patient messaging and conversational AI.
* Contribute to product discovery: identifying problems, testing concepts, and validating solutions (including AI\-generated outputs) with users and stakeholders.
* Monitor product and model performance after release; use feedback, quality metrics, and user input to guide iterative improvement.
* Support launch planning, alpha/beta feedback cycles, adoption activities, and resolution of production issues.
* Represent the voice of the customer in product and design discussions, balancing efficiency gains from AI against patient safety and data sensitivity considerations.
* Coordinate with legal, compliance, security, and patient safety partners on responsible\-AI review processes for messaging features.


**Collaboration Across Geographies**
* Work closely with US\-based product peers to align on workflow design, requirements, and roadmap sequencing.
* Contribute to measurement frameworks for feature and model performance within the zone.
* Support continuous improvement efforts across the product lifecycle, including documentation of AI feature behavior for internal and client\-facing teams.


**Expected Education \& Experience**
* Bachelor's degree required; a degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Business, or a related field preferred.
* 8\+ years of product management experience; healthcare or health technology experience preferred.
* Strong understanding of AI/ML concepts and how they apply to product delivery, including familiarity with model lifecycle concepts (training, validation, deployment, monitoring).
* Understanding of responsible AI principles \- bias, explainability, human oversight, and trust.
* Familiarity with data pipelines, data quality considerations, and experimentation methods (e.g., A/B testing of model\-driven features).
* Experience bringing AI\-driven or data\-intensive products to market and supporting adoption post\-launch.
* Technical understanding of mobile, SaaS, messaging infrastructure, and APIs sufficient to assess feasibility and timelines.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to translate complex AI/technical concepts for non\-technical stakeholders.
* Comfortable gathering requirements from globally distributed teams and coordinating delivery across geographies.


**About Athenahealth**
***Our vision:***
*In an industry that becomes more complex by the day, we stand for simplicity. We offer IT solutions and expert services that eliminate the daily hurdles preventing healthcare providers from focusing entirely on their patients — powered by our vision to create a thriving ecosystem that delivers accessible, high\-quality, and sustainable healthcare for all.*
***Our company culture:***
*Our talented* 
*employees — or athenistas, as we call ourselves — spark the innovation and passion needed to accomplish our vision. We are a diverse group of dreamers and do\-ers with unique knowledge, expertise, backgrounds, and perspectives. We unite as mission\-driven problem\-solvers with a deep desire to achieve our vision and make our time here count. Our award\-winning culture is built around shared values of inclusiveness, accountability, and support.*

jobs.title: Product Manager - Marketplace
jobs.description:
**About Us**
 As a Fortune 50 company with more than 400,000 team members worldwide, Target is an iconic brand and one of America's leading retailers. Joining Target means promoting a culture of mutual care and respect and striving to make the most meaningful and positive impact. Becoming a Target team member means joining a community that values different voices and lifts each other up. Here, we believe your unique perspective is
   

  

 important, and you'll build relationships by being authentic and respectful.
   

  

**Team Overview**
 Right along with Target’s distinctive retail brand, we are constantly improving and innovating our digital shopping experience. Are you ready to excel in the fast\-changing retail environment? Are you a customer service enthusiast who’s curious about the guest and can see the shopping journey through their eyes? Then you’ll have success on the Digital Strategy \& Platform team, whose goal is to offer guests a seamless online shopping experience across our platforms—including Target.com and the store network’s fulfillment capabilities. Here, you’ll collaborate to create and implement the digital strategies that enrich the online experience through the right mix of personalization, simplicity and intuitiveness. Your ideas will support Target in complementing the beloved in\-store shopping interaction with a convenient, reliable and instantly gratifying digital experience.
   

  

**Role Overview**
 As a Product Manager, you will work in the product model and will collaborate with your product team and key stakeholders to develop a plan and business objectives (OKRs) for your respective product. You will need to build a strong knowledge of your product through product discovery to collect customer feedback and work to collect other relevant data points that explain the value and help you prioritize the direction and desired outcomes for your product. You will work in unison with engineers, UX designers, data scientists and business partners to deliver a product.
   

  

 You will be the “voice of the product” with your product team and stakeholders to ensure that their needs are met, and you will be responsible to maintain and refine the product backlog (create user stories \& acceptance criteria) while prioritizing the backlog to focus on the highest impact work for your team and stakeholders.
   

  

 You will encourage the open exchange of information and viewpoints, as well as inspire others to achieve challenging goals and high standards of performance while committing to the organization's direction. You will foster sense of urgency to achieve goals and leverage resources to overcome unexpected obstacles.
   

  

 Core responsibilities of this job are to
 **Support Marketplace Portal (Seller Central)** 
 in connecting with enterprise systems, delivering end to end experience for third party sellers to run their business on Target.com.
